summary: Rwang Pam Stadium is a multi-use stadium located in Jos, Nigeria, used mainly for football matches. It serves as the home ground for three Jos-based clubs: JUTH F.C., Plateau United and Mighty Jets. The stadium has a capacity of 15,000 spectators.
one_line: Rwang Pam Stadium is a 15,000-capacity multi-use football stadium in Jos, Nigeria, home to JUTH F.C., Plateau United and Mighty Jets.
